newsitem.title: UK: S&P raises Banque Sofinco outlook.
newsitem.headline: S&P raises Banque Sofinco outlook.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Tuesday it affirmed its A minus senior unsecured and A2 commercial paper rating of Banque Sofinco, and that it upgraded the outlook on the company.
"The outlook has been revised to positive from stable. Sofinco's ratings principally reflect its 100 percent ownership by Compagnie de Suez," S&P said in a statement.

The A2 short-term rating on the French commercial paper programme of Suez Finance SA, guaranteed by Suez, is primarily based on the negative impact of the downturn in the French commercial property market on Suez's consolidated capital structure, S&P said.
"Though the group has started to drastically restructure this business, the full financial impact remains unknown."

Sofinco's asset quality has improved significantly in recent years, thanks to the fine-tuning of its scoring system and a clean-up of the high-risk revolving credit portfolio built up in the early 1990s, S&P said.

"As a consequence, Sofinco's profitability has significantly improved over the past two years with a return on assets above one percent since 1994 and a return on equity of over 20 percent. This last ratio is, however, boosted by Sofinco's low capital ratios," the agency said.

"The outlook revision reflects the progressive improvement in Suez group's financial situation. Thanks to its high and recurrent profitability, Sofinco has a key role into the latter's strategy," S&P said
S&P said it affirmed the Sofinco senior unsecured debt at A minus, certificates of deposit at A minus/A2, counterparty ratings at A minus/A-2 and commercial paper at A2.
